recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, full-body 3D character wearing a metallic purple puffer jacket and a heart-shaped helmet with glowing eyes, standing on rocky desert terrain. A small pool of water in the foreground creates a perfect vertical reflection showing a human figure in a yellow hoodie, set against a sunset mountain backdrop with floating butterflies.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between the character and its reflection
Contrast between the metallic purple of the figure and the warm orange sunset
Scale contrast between the vast desert and the small, delicate butterflies
Visual tension between the masked futuristic figure and the human reflection
coreInvariants: Heart-shaped helmet with glowing horizontal slit eyes
Metallic, iridescent texture on the puffer jacket
Water puddle as a mirror for identity reveal

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, full-body character occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing eyes of the helmet and the bright reflection in the water.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical path from the head, through the body, into the water reflection.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and desert floor provide breathing room around the central figure.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Metallic purple and deep blue (character's clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the character and sunset; lower saturation in the rocky foreground.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon greens or bright pinks
Maintain a warm-to-cool gradient from sky to ground
